source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of graph operations (PDF 114).

items: Insertion: vertex ya edge jorna, jaise naya shehar aur us ki sarkein.
Deletion: vertex ya edge hatana; shehar hatane se us ki tamam sarkein bhi hatti hain.

Traversal: BFS (pehle tamam qareebi parosi, level ba level, jaise aage jane se pehle markazi station se har train lena) ya DFS (shaakh mein jitna aage ja sake phir wapas, jaise ek rahdari aakhir tak dekh kar wapas aana) se tamam vertices munazzam tareeqe se dekhna.
Searching: koi khaas vertex ya edge dhoondna, jaise shehar ya raasta.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa traversal agle level se pehle vertex ke tamam qareebi parosi dekhta hai (MCQ 9)?

items: Graph ke amal: insert, delete, traverse (BFS, DFS), search.
